result.reason: The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but they do not fully reach the playbook position. Affiliate and contractor rights are added only to the Section 2.2 Internal Use License, not the Section 2.1 Hosting Software License. In addition, transfer remains subject to Section 14.1, which requires consent where an M&A successor is a direct competitor; thus transfer to an M&A successor is not unconditionally permitted even under the fallback. The paid-up Section 2.2 license is appropriately made perpetual and irrevocable, and no subscription license is present.
